title: SCT-Tech Enablement-Digital supply chain lead-FDE-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**SCT\-Tech Enablement \- Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front\-end and back\-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy full\-stack web applications using modern front\-end and back\-end technologies.
* Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Develop robust server\-side applications, APIs, and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Design and optimize relational and non\-relational databases to ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity.
* Integrate applications with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and event\-driven architectures.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge\-sharing across teams.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 6–10 years of hands\-on experience in full\-stack application development.
* Strong proficiency in front\-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js and Microsoft 365 technologies like PowerApps.
* Experience in back\-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event\-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test\-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr Engineer, Applications Development - SAP Hybris
description:
**The Opportunity**
 Implements tactical and operational goals focused on software build, release, deployment, and configuration management, ensuring seamless application delivery. Contributes to the implementation of new automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, testing methodologies, and deployment standards. Manages software deployment projects and operational processes, coordinating release schedules, dependency tracking, and integration workflows. Works on diverse, multifaceted challenges where analysis requires evaluating software performance, system compatibility, and implementation risks. Derives solutions based on limited precedent, applying best practices in release engineering, infrastructure automation, and software quality assurance to maintain stability and efficiency. Communicates regularly with internal stakeholders, including development, QA, IT operations, and product teams, as well as external vendors and cloud service providers to ensure timely implementation and support.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**Senior SAP Hybris Developer:**
 As a Senior member of the e\-commerce technology team, the developer will design, develop, and maintain scalable and secure e\-commerce solutions using SAP Hybris and manage junior members.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect \& Lead E\-commerce Platforms: Design and drive scalable, high\-performance, and secure end\-to\-end e\-commerce architectures aligned with enterprise strategy, industry best practices, and long\-term business goals.
* Technical Leadership \& Solution Design: Lead the design and development of complex e\-commerce solutions using SAP Commerce Cloud (SAP CC), Java, Spartacus/Angular, Node.js, Spring Framework, and modern microservices\-based architectures.
* Enterprise Integration Strategy: Architect and oversee seamless integrations with enterprise ecosystems including ERP, CRM, payment gateways, SSO, middleware, and external third\-party services, ensuring reliability and scalability.
* Domain Expertise \& Optimization: Provide deep functional and technical expertise across core e\-commerce domains such as customer profiles, product catalog, shopping cart, checkout flows, payments, pricing, quotes, and order management systems.
* Cross\-functional Leadership: Partner with business stakeholders (marketing, sales, finance, product, and IT leadership) to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and drive digital transformation initiatives.
* Mentorship \& Team Development: Mentor and guide junior and mid\-level developers, enforce coding standards, conduct design reviews, and foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Engineering Excellence \& Governance: Establish best practices for code quality, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, performance tuning, and security compliance. Lead code reviews, architecture reviews, and technical audits.
* Performance, Scalability \& Reliability: Proactively monitor and optimize system performance, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and scalability for high\-traffic, business\-critical e\-commerce platforms.
* Innovation \& Modernization: Evaluate and implement modern technologies, frameworks, and architectural patterns (e.g., headless commerce, microservices, cloud\-native solutions) to future\-proof the platform.
* Stakeholder Communication \& Delivery Ownership: Take ownership of technical delivery, manage risks, provide estimations, and communicate effectively with stakeholders, ensuring alignment on timelines, scope, and quality expectations.


**Requirements**
 v 8\+ years of E\-Commerce development with at least 6 years in SAP Hybris Commerce / SAP Cloud Commerce.
   

  

 v Hands on Experience on SAP Hybris Core Architecture, Backoffice Cockpits, Impex, SmartEdit and PCM/Backoffice Customization
   

  

 v Knowledge of Zul backend development and Solr search index build / querying
   

  

 v Hybris Item Types and Catalog Management: In\-depth knowledge of product information management and catalog structures.
   

  

 v Understanding of order processes, payment, shipping, and returns. Knowledge of customer profiles, segmentation, and personalization. Understanding of discount mechanisms, pricing rules, and promotions.
   

  

 v Experience integrating Hybris with external systems (ERP, CRM, PIM, etc.).
   

  

 v Java, J2EE (Servlets, JSP, JDBC, JMS, Transactions), Restful API, JSON, XML/XSLT, Java script, Angular / React
   

  

 v Experience on open\-source tools and frameworks: Spring, Hibernate, ANT, MAVEN, JUNIT.
   

  

 v Good knowledge and understanding of DOM, HTML, CSS and JavaScript OOP, MVC, Responsive, Javacript/Jquery and object\-oriented concepts.
   

  

 v Experience on either of Application Servers – JBOSS, Tomcat.
   

  

 v Experience working with Apache/Nginix.
   

  

 v Knowledge and understanding of relational database structure and design using Azure Sql server / Oracle / PostgreSql
   

  

 v Proficiency in Git for code management and collaboration.
   

  

 v Understanding of unit testing, integration testing, and automated testing frameworks.
   

  

**Disclaimer**

They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. title: Mulesoft Admin
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 A growing leader in enterprise integration and API\-led connectivity, we empower global organizations to unify fragmented systems, automate workflows, and accelerate digital transformation. Our MuleSoft practice delivers scalable, secure, and governed integration solutions across cloud and on\-prem environments—helping clients modernize legacy architecture and unlock real\-time data flow across Salesforce, SAP, AWS, and more.
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
* Administer, monitor, and optimize MuleSoft Anypoint Platform (Runtime Manager, API Manager, Access Management) across development, staging, and production environments.
* Deploy, configure, and manage Mule Runtime instances on\-prem and in cloud (AWS, Azure), ensuring high availability, performance, and security compliance.
* Implement and enforce CI/CD pipelines for Mule applications using Jenkins, Git, and Anypoint Platform APIs.
* Configure and manage API Gateways, TLS/SSL certificates, OAuth2, and SSO for secure API access and governance.
* Collaborate with developers and architects to troubleshoot deployment failures, performance bottlenecks, and connectivity issues across hybrid environments.
* Document platform configurations, deployment runbooks, and operational playbooks to ensure team readiness and audit compliance.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Must\-Have**
* MuleSoft Anypoint Platform
* Runtime Manager
* API Manager
* CloudHub
* AWS EC2 / Azure VMs
* Jenkins
* Git
* OAuth2


**Preferred**
* MuleSoft Certified Administrator
* Ansible / Terraform
* CloudFormation / ARM Templates


**Benefits \& Culture Highlights**
* Work with Fortune 500 clients on mission\-critical integration projects that drive digital transformation.
* Access to continuous upskilling and certification support in MuleSoft and cloud platforms.
* On\-site collaborative workspace with modern infrastructure and cross\-functional engineering teams.


 Skills: mulesoft,ci/cd,platform architecture

**The opportunity**
 AI Architect\- SC products: We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain AI Solution Architect to join our Digital Supply Chain Team. This hybrid role combines enterprise AI architecture, Supply Chain taxonomies and knowledge graph, product thinking, and client advisory to translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions that deliver measurable value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to identify AI opportunities and translate requirements into scalable AI solution architectures.
* Design and architect enterprise\-grade AI applications leveraging LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Multimodal AI patterns.
* Define end\-to\-end AI solution architectures, including model selection, data retrieval strategy, orchestration frameworks, deployment models, and integration patterns.
* Design and implement advanced prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and memory management strategies.
* Architect hybrid retrieval solutions using vector search, semantic search, GraphRAG, SQL\-based retrieval, and vectorless approaches.
* Design and implement MCP\-based integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and business systems.
* Establish AI platform standards covering observability, evaluation frameworks, LLMOps, monitoring, governance, performance optimization, and cost management.
* Define AI security architectures addressing prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, jailbreak attempts, and AI\-specific threats.
* Ensure compliance with Responsible AI principles, privacy regulations, governance requirements, and security standards.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical assessments, proof\-of\-concepts, and production\-readiness evaluations.
* Drive AI adoption across business and technology teams through workshops, technical leadership, and stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor AI engineers, architects, and developers while defining best practices, reusable frameworks, and reference architectures.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends to drive continuous innovation.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, data engineering, enterprise architecture, or related technology domains.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, Generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, embeddings, reranking, and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of AI agent architectures, multi\-agent systems, tool calling, memory strategies, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Proficiency in Python, API development, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their AI services.
* Strong understanding of databases, data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Practical experience with MCP, REST APIs, JSON\-RPC, OAuth, and secure integration frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, and AI cost optimization.
* Understanding of model fine\-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, model routing, quantization, and inference optimization techniques.
* Experience with multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, SQL agents, and advanced retrieval architectures.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, architecture documentation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business outcomes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Familiarity with vector databases and search platforms such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Neo4j.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, vLLM, Langfuse, Ragas, DeepEval, and AI platform engineering practices.
* Understanding of AI governance and security frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI Security, ISO/IEC 42001, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading enterprise AI transformation initiatives, Centers of Excellence (CoE), or AI capability building programs.
* Exposure to MLOps, DataOps, and enterprise deployment strategies for scalable AI solutions.
